description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure Azure Table Storage-based reminder service in an Orleans application. It provides multiple overloads of UseAzureTableReminderService for different configuration scenarios, such as direct configuration delegates, options builders, and connection strings.

classes.description: Contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to integrate Azure Table Storage as a reminder store.
